newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian bullion trade shut for local festival.
newsitem.headline: Indian bullion trade shut for local festival.

text.p: India's gold and silver markets were shut on Monday for a local religious holiday, dealers said.
They remain closed on Tuesday and reopen on Wednesday.
On Friday, Indian silver erased some early losses on the back of industrial and seasonal buying but a weak global trend kept prices lower, dealers said.
"Arrivals of imported silver continued and sentiment remained subdued at the close of the session," one dealer said.
Gold opened on a quiet note but slid towards close on Friday on fresh arrivals. Gold was down by 30 rupees per 10 gramme on Thursday.
Prices of a gold biscuit (116.50 gramme) settled 50 rupees lower at 59,800 rupees per piece. Gold biscuits were down by 350 rupees on Thursday.
